'''Ballard''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He served in the [[Republic Army]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On Coruscant, he worked out of the Equipment Requisitions area of the [[Senate Commercial District]] where he trained [[Republic trooper]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ballard first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class trainer for the trooper class. He is only accessible to Republic players in the game as he is found on Coruscant which is a Republic-only planet.
